verified: Frozen 24 backend pairs, 72 reference/reuse/rebuild controls and 144 timed runs, using fresh processes and raw starts.
Original inputs, raw starts, binaries, compiled source, dependencies and runtime are pinned by SHA256; preparation and summary invoke no optimizer.
A single numerical thread on CPU 0; foreign work is monitored on all CPU cores; termination targets only owned process groups.

Resume validates immutable raw artifacts, recovers the first finalized clean attempt including numerical failure, and checks for previously owned live solver/audit processes in both phase directories.
Qualification checks actual commands, threads, budgets, backend routes, original audit input/endpoint hashes, all nonclock numerical/work fields, and every ordered trace field except mode.
A native final session plus complete model summaries bind construction and reuse counts; the legitimate zero-model path requires explicit native zero.
Pure cache-cost ratios require three certified repetitions per mode, endpoint/work parity, repetition stability and actual cache exercise; every mismatch and inactive pair remains reported.

Study wrapper APIs, historical default paths and the 216-run count agree; the plan and selected build are pinned, partial builds are retained, and completion requires all 144 measurements plus valid qualification.

findings.problem: Empty JSONL and complete=False model rows were accepted.
findings.resolution: Complete model rows plus final session footer and explicit native zero-model proof now required.

findings.problem: Initial trace reader omitted outer/origin and did not accept controller event.
findings.resolution: All declared trace fields except intervention mode compared; schema/mode/per-instance event counts and order checked.

findings.problem: Strict success alone could qualify different numerical endpoints for pure cache-cost speed summary.
findings.resolution: Timed endpoint/work parity and repeat stability gate ratios; differences retained without rerun; valid native qualification required.

findings.problem: Final hash parsing of malformed completed endpoint could raise after initial error handling and allow numerical rerun on resume.
findings.resolution: Malformed endpoint/audit becomes finalized indeterminate outcome; no unguarded final parsing; audit input/endpoint hashes checked.

limits: This independent review used synthetic controller processes and fixtures; no QCQP solver was run by this reviewer.
Full native MUMPS validation is a separate build-agent task; production MA27/MUMPS qualification on the 24 pairs remains to be run on TRX.
The CPU quiet threshold does not certify absence of memory, I/O, thermal or frequency contention.
